blocks.prompt: 12 A line of 70 dominoes is set up so that when the first domino falls, it causes the second domino to fall, and so on. Prove that if the first domino falls, all 70 dominoes will fall.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 'domino effect' hai, yani woh tasveer jis se mathematical induction samajh aata hai.
Statement banayenge: \(P(n)\): '\(n\)wan domino girta hai', \(n = 1, 2, \dots, 70\).
Plan: base case 'pehla domino girta hai' se, aur induction step dominoes ki tarteeb se, phir nateeja.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 70 dominoes ek line mein; har girta hua domino agle ko gira deta hai; pehla domino girta hai.
Saabit karna hai: tamam 70 dominoes girte hain.
Tareeqa: Domino ki position \(n\) par mathematical induction, \(1 \le n \le 70\). Induction ke do hisse hain: shuru sahi ho (base case), aur har sahi qadam agla qadam sahi kare (induction step).

Statement
\[P(n):\ \text{the } n\text{th domino falls}\]
Kyun: Humein \(P(1), P(2), \dots, P(70)\) sab ko sahi dikhana hai. Ek ek ko alag saabit karna lamba kaam hai; induction ek hi dafa sab ko saabit kar deta hai.

Base case
\[P(1) \text{ is true}\]
Kyun: Sawal mein diya hai ke pehla domino girta hai. Yeh pehli seedhi hai.

Induction hypothesis
\[\text{Assume } P(k),\quad 1 \le k \le 69\]
Kyun: Farz karein ke koi \(k\)wan domino gir gaya, jahan \(k\) aakhri domino se pehle ka hai (warna agla domino hai hi nahi).

Induction step
\[P(k) \Rightarrow P(k + 1)\]
Kyun: Dominoes is tarah lagaye gaye hain ke girta hua domino apne agle domino ko gira deta hai. Is liye jab \(k\)wan girta hai to \((k + 1)\)wan bhi girta hai.
Dhyan dein: Sirf base case kaafi nahi (pehla gire lekin agle tak na pohanche to baqi khare rahenge), aur sirf step bhi kaafi nahi (koi pehla domino giraye hi na to kuch nahi girega). Dono zaroori hain.

Nateeja
\[P(1) \Rightarrow P(2) \Rightarrow \dots \Rightarrow P(70)\]
Kyun: \(P(1)\) sahi hai, aur har sahi case agle ko sahi kar deta hai, is liye mathematical induction ke principle se tamam 70 statements sahi hain.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: agar pehla domino girta hai to tamam 70 dominoes girenge.
